detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Processing in Musical Experience and Curiosity
detail.summary: We have synthesized existing evidence regarding the role of predictive processing in both musical engagement and curiosity-driven exploration. By mapping the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) hypothesis and active interoceptive inference models to our current project structures, we have identified convergent mechanisms that explain how agents calibrate against temporal sequences. These provisional notebooks formalize our current understanding, grounding our projects in established theoretical frameworks while highlighting the need for further experimental validation of these emergent behaviors.

detail.title: Predictive Dynamics and Musical Emotion
detail.summary: Exploration of how the brain's predictive mechanisms, particularly the ASAP hypothesis, facilitate emotional engagement with music through temporal calibration.
detail.reason: Synthesis of evidence establishes the provisional basis for predictive dynamics in musical experience.
